description: The code a Compare Scenarios node writes for its inputs (#662). compareCode.test.ts checks that compareCode.ts writes exactly this; test_compare_scenarios_node.py resolves each case's chips as a run on the server does and runs it through the sandbox's stacking step.

cases.name: two scenarios
cases.code:
# Compare Scenarios writes this code from its inputs: each input, under the
# id and the name of its scenario. It is written again when they change.
return curio_stack_scenarios([
    ("s-base", "Baseline", [!! input 0 !!]),
    ("s-tall", "Twice as tall", [!! input 1 !!]),
])
